meta.build: Next.js 16.3.5 production build, SITE_INDEXABLE=1, SITE_URL=https://evefertilityclinic.com, 107 indexable pages

issues.title: 261 Title Case H3 headings across 59 blog files
issues.evidence: e.g. 'What Should You Discuss With Your Doctor?', 'Step 4: Trigger Injection and Egg Collection'. Sentence-case is used by the older conditions/services pages; only the new blog batch uses Title Case.
issues.fix: Lowercase all words except the first word and proper nouns in ### headings. e.g. 'What should you discuss with your doctor?'

issues.title: 3 legacy unclustered posts cannibalise cluster articles
issues.evidence: Each pair targets near-identical intent: 'PCOS and Getting Pregnant: What the Evidence Says' vs 'PCOS and Pregnancy: Natural Conception'; 'Fertility tests explained: AMH, semen analysis, HSG and scans' vs 'Female Infertility Tests: AMH, Ultrasound, Hormones, HSG'; 'when to see a fertility doctor' vs 'how long to try before seeing a fertility specialist'.
issues.fix: For each pair either merge into the stronger page with a 301 redirect, or rewrite titles/intros/FAQs so each page owns a distinct intent (e.g. keep the legacy page as the broad 'tests' overview and narrow the cluster post to female-only workup). Add the surviving legacy posts to clusters or remove them from the index.

issues.title: Markdown tables render as literal pipe text on 2 posts
issues.evidence:
Blank lines separate every table row ('| Feature | IUI | IVF |' then blank line then '|---|---|'), so GFM never parses a table. Raw HTML shows the pipe text inside

elements; no is emitted. 33 files use tables; only these 2 have broken rows.
issues.fix: Remove the blank lines between table rows in resources/content/blog/amh-vs-egg-quality-difference.md and iui-vs-ivf-which-fertility-treatment.md (and in resources/docs/new-website-content.md if that is the source of truth), then re-split.

issues.title: FAQ answers too short on ~45 supporting posts
issues.pages: Most supporting blog posts, e.g. /blog/can-you-get-pregnant-naturally-low-amh/ (17-27 words), /blog/how-long-try-conceive-before-fertility-specialist/ (17-29), /blog/iui-vs-ivf-which-fertility-treatment/ (20-33)
issues.evidence: Extracted answer word counts: supporting posts mostly 17-38 words vs the 40-60 word guideline. Pillars and condition/service pages meet 40-60.
issues.fix: Expand each short answer to 40-60 words: keep the direct first sentence, then add one concrete detail (number, timeframe, exception) and one 'what to do next' clause.

issues.title: 7 supporting posts link to fewer than 2 siblings
issues.evidence: Counted unique same-cluster URLs across body links, related: and posts: frontmatter.
issues.fix: Add 1-2 in-copy links to same-cluster siblings plus list them in posts: frontmatter.

issues.title: Endometriosis cluster never links to a service/treatment page
issues.pages: All 6 pages in cluster 'Endometriosis' incl. pillar /blog/endometriosis-fertility-symptoms-diagnosis-treatment-ivf/
issues.evidence: Zero /services/ or /treatments/ URLs in body links, related: or posts:. The cluster links to /conditions/endometriosis/ only.
issues.fix: Add contextual links to /treatments/ivf/, /treatments/iui/ and /services/fertility-evaluation/ where the copy discusses those options.

issues.title: 3 posts render 'Published' with an empty date
issues.evidence: datePublished is '[CONFIRM: launch date]' so the chip renders nothing in production: 'Written by Dr. Swati Shree... · Published  · Updated 4 September 2026'. JSON-LD datePublished is also pruned.
issues.fix: Either supply real dates in frontmatter or drop the 'Published' label when the value is a CONFIRM. Prefer real dates before launch.

issues.title: Citations exist in JSON-LD but no visible Sources block on 4 pages
issues.evidence: These files use the legacy inline 'Sources:' trailer which the loader removes from the body for JSON-LD citation[]. The 85 pages with '### Sources' sections render a visible <details class='pg-sources'> block; these 4 render nothing.
issues.fix: Convert the inline 'Sources:' lines into '### Sources' sections with linked entries so readers and crawlers see the references.

issues.title: 4 titles under 50 chars; 2 descriptions under 140 chars
issues.fix: Lengthen titles toward 50-60 chars with qualifier + location (e.g. 'Thyroid Problems and Fertility: Tests and Treatment'). Lengthen the two legal descriptions.

issues.title: /blog/ index has no visible breadcrumb
issues.evidence: crawl: hasBreadcrumb=false on /blog/ only; BreadcrumbList schema is present.
issues.fix: Render <Breadcrumbs items=[{label:'Blog'}]> in BlogIndexPage.

issues.title: No INR cost content anywhere on the site
issues.evidence: grep for ₹/INR/Rs/rupee across resources/content: 0 hits. 'IVF cost in Bangalore', 'IUI cost' etc. are high-volume PAA questions the site does not answer; AI engines will cite competitors for cost queries.
issues.fix: Add a 'What it costs' section (with honest ranges and a 'confirm at consultation' note) to IVF, IUI, egg-freezing and HSG pages, or a dedicated costs page — needs client-approved price ranges first.

issues.title: Windows autocrlf checkout breaks build-check (114 phantom link errors)
issues.evidence: With core.autocrlf=true, git writes CRLF; the frontmatter regex /^---\n/ then fails so urls are never registered and every internal link to those pages errors. Production/Vercel (LF checkout) is unaffected.
issues.fix: Add '*.md text eol=lf' to .gitattributes and/or make build-check split lines on /\r?\n/.

issues.title: 'Medically reviewed by' appears only at page bottom
issues.evidence: PostPage shows 'Written by ... Published ... Updated' in the header; ReviewerBox sits after the article body.
issues.fix: Add a compact 'Medically reviewed by Dr. Swati Shree, MRCOG (UK)' line to the post header meta row.

issues.title: robots.txt allow-list misses some AI user agents; /styleguide and /thank-you not disallowed
issues.evidence: Allowed: Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended. Not named: Claude-User, Perplexity-User, Applebot, CCBot, anthropic-ai (catch-all still allows them). /styleguide and /thank-you carry meta noindex but are not Disallowed.
issues.fix: Optional: extend the AI_BOTS list; optionally add Disallow /styleguide/ and /thank-you/ for belt-and-braces.

issues.title: Home page has no sitemap <lastmod>
issues.evidence: lastmod omitted because home lastReviewed is a CONFIRM placeholder.
issues.fix: Supply a real lastReviewed date for index.md at launch.

issues.title: No site.webmanifest
issues.evidence: favicon.ico, icon.png, apple-icon.png all 200; no manifest link or file.
issues.fix: Add app/manifest.ts (name, short_name, icons, theme_color #F8F3EA).

issues.title: Doctor entity has no sameAs; about-nodes lack Wikipedia/MeSH sameAs
issues.evidence: Physician node sameAs is CONFIRM-pruned (socials pending). about nodes emit name/alternateName only.
issues.fix: Add confirmed social/profile URLs as sameAs when client supplies them; add sameAs to MedicalCondition/MedicalProcedure about nodes pointing at Wikipedia/MeSH.

issues.title: Identical article template on all 63 posts
issues.evidence: Every post: H1 > 'Quick answer' callout > 'In brief' bullets > sections > FAQs > AuthorBox > ReviewerBox > RelatedLinks. Strong for AEO but uniform-structure is a checklist-53 tell.
issues.fix: Acceptable as a design system; vary section order and lead format on a subset where natural.

issues.title: ~120 [CONFIRM]/[date] placeholders across 34 content files
issues.evidence: OPD hours/times, clinic email, ART registry number, social URLs, payment methods, legal last-updated dates, 3 posts' datePublished.
issues.fix: Collect from client; npm run launch-check already enforces these before indexing.

issues.title: Reading level FK ~9-13 vs target 7-9
issues.evidence: Measured on 5 sample pages; inflated by unavoidable medical terms (intrauterine, fertilisation, gynaecology).
issues.fix: Shorten the longest sentences; keep the medical+plain-term pairing already in use.

issues.title: Host canonicalisation (www/non-www, http->https) is infra-dependent
issues.evidence: Canonicals/OG/sitemap all hard-code https://evefertilityclinic.com; 308 trailing-slash redirect verified locally. www vs apex redirect must be configured at DNS/host (Vercel domain settings).
issues.fix: At launch set evefertilityclinic.com as primary in Vercel; redirect www->apex and http->https (Vercel does http->https automatically).

issues.title: BlogPosting.mentions is empty on most posts
issues.evidence: mentions:[] seen in JSON-LD where meta.entities is unset.
issues.fix: Populate entities: frontmatter (2-5 key entities per post) or derive mentions from the about node.

issues.title: Root layout fallback description is thin
issues.evidence: src/app/layout.tsx: description 'EVE Women and Fertility Clinic, Gunjur, Bangalore.' Used only where a page lacks meta.description (none currently).
issues.fix: Optional: expand the fallback description.
